name: claude-code
description: Supervise Claude Code sessions: live and historical observation, plus launch, terminate, and prompt via the Agent SDK.
tier_note: Ships with Command Center; installed by `uv sync --all-groups`.

name: aider
description: Observe Aider sessions. Observation only - no launch or control.
tier_note: Ships with Command Center; installed by `uv sync --all-groups`.

name: codex
description: Observe Codex CLI sessions. Observation only - no launch or control.
tier_note: Ships with Command Center; installed by `uv sync --all-groups`.

name: ollama
description: Write the daily digest prose with a local Ollama model. Also powers Mjolnir's persona rephraser.
tier_note: Ships with Command Center; installed by `uv sync --all-groups`.

name: mjolnir
description: The offline voice client: wake word, speech-to-text, and a spoken assistant that answers questions and approves permissions by voice.
tier_note: Mjolnir is a paid extension. Add your licence key under Model storage settings to install it.

name: openwakeword
description: Wake-word detection for Mjolnir. Runs on CPU; ships stock models until a custom one is trained.
tier_note: Ships with Command Center; installed by `uv sync --all-groups`.

name: faster-whisper
description: Default speech-to-text for Mjolnir. CPU-capable, and uses the GPU when a CUDA 12 runtime is installed machine-wide.
tier_note: Ships with Command Center; installed by `uv sync --all-groups`.

requires.note: Runs on CPU anywhere. Its only GPU path is CUDA 12 + cuDNN 9 installed machine-wide; for GPU without CUDA use parakeet with DirectML instead.

name: parakeet
description: NVIDIA Parakeet speech-to-text via ONNX Runtime. Higher accuracy than the default; runs on CPU, faster on GPU.
tier_note: Ships with Command Center; installed by `uv sync --all-groups`.

requires.note: GPU without CUDA: install onnxruntime-directml and set providers to ["DmlExecutionProvider"] - works on any DX12 GPU. Downloads a ~600MB model on first use, and runs on CPU if you skip the GPU entirely.

name: piper
description: Offline text-to-speech for Mjolnir. Note: GPL-3.0, which is why it is an optional package rather than a core dependency.
tier_note: Ships with Command Center; installed by `uv sync --all-groups`.
